content.text: If you're a devoted iHeartRadio listener, you'll have an instinct for the iHeartRadio Music Awards, which celebrates the most-played songs and artists on the broadcaster's stations and app – in other words, the ones you might well be sick of! Having kept a low profile since "The Life of a Showgirl" landed with a thud (and the Chiefs failed to make the NFL playoffs), Taylor Swift has confirmed that she'll grace the Dolby Theatre in LA with her presence.You can watch iHeartRadio Music Awards 2026 online from anywhere with a VPN. Swipe to scroll horizontally Swift needn't be too down on herself. She's in the running for nine awards, followed by Alex Warren, Bad Bunny and Sabrina Carpenter with eight nominations apiece, and she's been getting a whole lot of love in the fan-voted categories too.11 awards – Favorite Broadway Debut, Favorite TikTok Dance, Favorite Debut Album, Favorite Lyrics, Best Music Video, Favorite On Screen, Favorite Tour Photographer, Favorite Soundtrack, Favorite Tour Style, Favorite Tour Tradition and Favorite K-pop Collab – are decided by fans, who were able to cast up to 50 votes per day in each category before voting closed last week.
